title.zh: 建屋发展（升级工程分区）（家居改进计划）（第 4 号）命令 2025
title.en: Housing and Development (Precincts for Upgrading Works) (Home Improvement Programme) (No. 4) Order 2025

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Housing and Development (Precincts for Upgrading Works) (Home Improvement Programme) (No. 4) Order 2025 and comes into operation on 5 September 2025.

heading.en: Declaration of precincts for Home Improvement Programme

text.en: 2. The parts of the housing estates of the Board described in the Schedule are declared to be precincts for the purposes of carrying out upgrading works in connection with the Home Improvement Programme.

THE SCHEDULE
1. All that part of the housing estate of the Board bounded by Bedok North Avenue 3 and Bedok North Street 2, comprised in Lot number 08197X in Mukim 27 and on which Apartment Block 140 is erected, which block is marked with a grey dot in Plan 1.
Plan 1
BEDOK NORTH STREET 2
2. All that part of the housing estate of the Board bounded by Choa Chu Kang Avenue 3, Choa Chu Kang Central, Choa Chu Kang Avenue 1 and Choa Chu Kang Way, comprised in Lot number 01377T in Mukim 11 and on which Apartment Blocks 223, 224, 225, 226 and 227 are erected, in Lot number 01148W in Mukim 11 and on which Apartment Blocks 228 and 229 are erected, in Lot number 01240W in Mukim 11 and on which Apartment Blocks 230, 231, 235, 237, 238 and 239 are erected, in Lot number 01384X in Mukim 11 and on which Apartment Blocks 232 and 233 are erected, and in Lot number 01132C in Mukim 11 and on which Apartment Blocks 234 and 236 are erected, which blocks are each marked with a grey dot in Plan 2.
Plan 2
